Corrections: Illinois FAIR Plan website was a dead/parked domain (now illinoisfairplan.com); Hartville Pet website pointed to an unrelated village site; AAA Western & Central NY phone was the national roadside number. Removed: CSE Insurance (site states no active policies in force; claims via 800-282-6848) and AAA Schuylkill County (merged). Merger notes added: MetLife Auto & Home -> Farmers GroupSelect, Metromile -> Lemonade, Lemonade Life -> Banner Life, Liberty National/Family Heritage now Globe Life divisions, Safeco servicing via Liberty Mutual eService. Caveat: 'verified' flags on roster entries set by earlier agents were not all re-checked; two wrong roster websites were found in a title scan of all 310 websites, which otherwise showed no parked or unrelated domains (bot-blocked sites: Trupanion, Physicians Mutual, Neptune, John Hancock, MassMutual, Shelter, COUNTRY, NJM, Aflac, Farmers/Foremost/Bristol West, PURE, QBE, Symetra, Sagicor). The shared web-search budget was exhausted, so this pass relied on direct fetches, sitemaps and homepage link extraction. Completeness checked against: the existing file's lists (FEMA WYO list, I.I.I. top writers, the state FAIR/beach-plan list of about 33 states plus DC, now plus CO), the AAA club list in the file, and fraternal life insurers named in the task.
